title: Create an OTA and follow its set-up
caption: PF-10, PF-11. Needs the platform worker, the OTA worker and the Amadeus stub.

steps.title: Open the wizard
steps.expect: `/otas/new`, step 1 "OTA details"; the time zone is the account's own.

steps.title: OTA details
steps.body: OTA name (the key follows it), OTA key, country, default currency, time zone; **Continue**.
steps.expect: "Storefront address: <key>.ota.example.com" and "This key is available." A taken or reserved key (`admin`, `demo`, `test`…) keeps you on step 1.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: Before M5: early access is preselected. With `FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING` on: pick a plan and the Annual billing switch.
steps.expect: Plans in `sort_order`; a plan without a Stripe price for the interval is disabled with the reason.

steps.title: Review and create
steps.body: Check every value, **Create OTA** (M5: "Create OTA and continue to payment"). Double-click to test idempotency.
steps.expect: `/otas/ten_…/setup` (M5: Stripe Checkout). One `platform.tenants` row (`provisioning`), owner membership, subscription (`trialing`/`manual` pre-M5), sub-domain, one `provisioning_jobs` row.

steps.title: Watch the set-up
steps.body: Stay on the page; it polls every 2 seconds.
steps.expect: "Your OTA is ready" within about a minute; `tenants.status = 'active'`, `schema_version` set, test Amadeus office assigned, Stripe test connection, two test keys; e-mail "<OTA> is ready on Velexis".

steps.title: Reveal the test keys
steps.expect: `pk_test_…` and `sk_test_…` shown once; reload → "The initial keys were already shown"; `provisioning_jobs.revealed_at` set and `reveal_ciphertext` null.

steps.title: Overview
steps.expect: "Get your OTA ready" checklist: Verify your e-mail, Turn on two-factor sign-in, OTA set up, Get your API keys, Open your storefront, Amadeus test office active Done; Invite your team To do (M5 items appear only with their switches).
